learn.learn.helpSignIn: Sign in with Google to share clips.
learn.learn.helpKids: Never on while the Kids space is on.
learn.learn.hkNone: No clips are waiting. Thank you!
learn.learn.hkOnly: This page is for the teachers who review clips.
learn.learn.hkAsk: Listen to the word in bold. Were its harakat said right?
learn.learn.skippedN: Skipped or said differently: {n}. They are marked; untap any the phone misheard.
learn.learn.simLead: Ayat that are easy to mix up. The words that differ are marked.
learn.learn.tapMissed: Tap any word you missed or said wrong.
learn.learn.noSlips: No slips. Be honest with yourself: tap any word you missed.
learn.learn.noMic: The microphone could not be used. You can still recite without recording.
learn.learn.pmLead: Always the same Madinah page. Learn where each ayah sits, how each line and page begins, and keep every page strong.
learn.learn.pmStartsHint: Only the first word of each line shows. Recite each line, then tap it to check.
learn.learn.tvPreviewNote: This is what it becomes when you hold the whole surah.
learn.learn.tvHint: Pinch or double-tap to look closer.
learn.learn.lampsBody: A wrong answer in a new lesson's exercises dims one lamp. When none is lit, new lessons rest until a lamp comes back. Reviews, tasmi' and page memory never need a lamp, so your Quran never waits.
learn.learn.lampsDay: One lamp comes back every {m} minutes, and all five are lit again each new day.
learn.learn.lampsEarnPages: Recite a page you know · +1 lamp
learn.learn.lampsNoLight: You need {n} Light to light all five
learn.learn.lampsOutSub: New lessons wait until a lamp comes back. Your Quran never waits: review, recite or listen any time.
learn.learn.lampsGo: A lamp is lit · Carry on
learn.learn.fixSub: The words you missed. Tap one to hear it.
